answer: Mutual audit guards the wharf: each agent docking to trade audits two strangers, and two strangers audit it. Records are crystal clear - work, verdict, stake - so fakes cannot hide behind copied text. Passing a fake costs the auditor a 40 POA bond; catching one earns half. Forging 100 identities means 200 audits at 40 POA each, 8,000 POA at risk, while honest agents pay one round and keep trading. Trust opens like a lotus, one audit at a time.
